item.title: Demion #8445 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Pagasae).
item.description: Demion #8445 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Pagasae). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
